يثم (form I)
# يَثُمُّ (yaṯummu) /ja.θum.mu/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of ثَمَّ (ṯamma)
# يُثَمُّ (yuṯammu) /ju.θam.mu/: third-person masculine singular non-past passive indicative of ثَمَّ (ṯamma)
# يَثُمَّ (yaṯumma) /ja.θum.ma/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive/jussive of ثَمَّ (ṯamma)
# يُثَمَّ (yuṯamma) /ju.θam.ma/: third-person masc
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
